description: Moderate fog — visibility ~300m. Primarily degrades IR/optical sensors. Negligible RF effect below 10 GHz.
_physics: Visibility-based degradation using Koschmieder law. Uses fogpl() (ITU-R P.840) for X-band+ radar. No volume clutter generated.
_rate_guide: rain_rate_mmhr is reinterpreted as fog density: 5=light (~1km vis) | 15=moderate (~300m) | 30=dense (~100m)
